Circus (Audience) Shirt.x: The Circus (Audience) Shirt is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be obtained through Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza as part of the Circus (Audience) outfit. It is unlocked alongside its item version.

Clue scroll (elite) - East Kharidian Des.x: Clue scroll (elite) is a scan clue obtained from elite sealed clue scrolls. It contains a clue to solve Treasure Trails.

sc: Clue scroll (master) is an anagram clue obtained from master sealed clue scrolls.
Clue scroll (medium) is a coordinate clue obtained from medium sealed clue scrolls.
The unenchanted version can be obtained by killing moss giants in Glarial's Tomb.
Corrupted Wild Magic scroll is an unlock token that may be awarded from Santa's Christmas Presents starting in 2025.

Courier cape.x: Courier cape is a back slot cosmetic override that is part of the Courier outfit.

sc: It is unlocked by completing the achievement Seren Memories, searching the alcove storage on the west side of the Sanctum on Freneskae after depositing all four Seren memoriam crystals.
Player should search the storage and finish the dialogue to obtain the cosmetic override and the achievement.
Defence XP lamp is a lamp rewarded for completion of the Dragon Slayer quest.

Dervish robe (pink).x: The pink dervish robe is part of the dervish outfit. This gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: The desert amulet 3 is an amulet received by completing the easy, medium and hard Desert achievements, and is given to the player by Hakeem the Mayor in pollnivneach, who will also replace the amulet if lost, provided that the desert amulet 4 hasn't been unlocked yet.
The amulet's teleport looks similar to the tornado emote purchased from the Loyalty Rewards programme.
Desert Treasure (Fareed), also known as Fire warrior armour, is a cosmetic override set that is unlocked by owning every item of the Fire warrior outfit.
It can be created with 500 codex pages using the lectern on Anachronia.
This version cannot be bought from or sold to other players or the Grand Exchange, but it requires fewer codex pages than the tradeable version, which requires 750 codex pages.
The dragonbone mage hat is created by using the Dragonbone upgrade kit on an Infinity hat.
After completing the subquest, they can be purchased from Rohak for 100 coins each without extra ingredients.
An early bird lamp was a lamp received for reaching wave 30 of the Fight Kiln minigame within two weeks of its release, which ended on 29 February 2012.

Elemental (Stoneheart) Greaves.x: Elemental (Stoneheart) Greaves is a legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Elemental (Stoneheart) set.

sc: The emerald golem head is part of the emerald golem outfit that is created from 3,600 gemstone golem fragments with level 80 Mining and 20 Invention.
It was previously available from Treasure Hunter.

Explosive potion.x: Explosive potions are found on tables in the Castle Wars equipment rooms. They can be used to instantly destroy barricades or destroy the enemy catapult.

sc: They are obtained from ogre coffins, which will often break lockpicks and decrease players' Thieving level.

Feline Ears.x: Feline Ears is a head slot cosmetic override that is part of the Feline set.

sc: Fire runes can be created from rune essence or pure essence through the Runecrafting skill, procured from drops by killing monsters, bought from other players, picked up from spawns on the ground, or can sometimes be found inside barrels in the Viyeldi caves.
Fire runes can be created using the Runecrafting skill at level 14 with a fire talisman or fire tiara at the fire altar in Al Kharid, which gives 7 experience per essence used.
It is part of the first tower robe armour, a reward for the completion of Rune Memories.

It can be purchased from the Smuggled Goods shop for 3 frozen tokens.
General Graardor's head is a boss trophy obtained from defeating General Graardor.
The Giftwrapped Bow Token (Untradeable) is an unlock token available from the 2025 variant of purple Christmas Present.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Giftwrapped Bow override, destroying it in the process after a confirmation prompt.
Golden chaotic claw is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased alongside its off-hand variant for 1 golden cosmetic token from the Golden Goods shop.
Golden chaotic spear is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 1 golden cosmetic token from the Golden Goods shop.
The golem framework is a relic component which can be created at an inventor's workbench under the misc.
A grimy tarromin is a herb dropped by various monsters or harvested from a tarromin plant grown from a tarromin seed in a herb patch, requiring level 19 Farming.
Grotesque (Tier 1) Boots is a feet slot cosmetic override that can be purchased for 200 credits from the Trader's Store or for 1,500 Double XP Tokens from the DXP Token Store.

sc: A purple hat can be purchased from Barker at his store, Barker's Haberdashery, in Canifis.

It can be obtained by cooking a raw hogfish on a fire or range, requiring level 69 Cooking and granting 170 Cooking experience when cooking on a range or 187 Cooking experience when cooking on a bonfire.

Horizon is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that is unlocked by claiming 15 prizes from the Advent Calendar (2021) interface on the first day that each becomes available, from 1 December to 24 December 2021.
It can be purchased from Boni's Waiko Reward Shop on Waiko for 1,000 chimes.
The igneous fruit is a type of Jadinko fruit that can be found in the Jadinko Lair, received through the offering stone or from Mutated jadinko drops.
The ignition system is obtained by a collector role after using a broken helm on the anvil in the eastern part of the cave.
It can be won on Treasure Hunter during the Cerberus Rush promotion.
It can be created by combining 3,600 trapper fragments.
It could be obtained from the Elite Trapper Outfits Treasure Hunter promotion.

K'ril's Godcrusher Winged Cape.x: K'ril's Godcrusher Winged Cape is a back slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the K'ril's Godcrusher outfit.

sc: The katagon chainbody is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.

Lunar legs (blue).x: The lunar legs are a piece of Lunar equipment worn in the legwear slot. They can be recoloured into green, red, and yellow or back to their original colour by using them on Diango after purchasing the Lunar Equipment (re-colour) service from Solomon's General Store for 2,000 Loyalty Points or by claiming the Loyalty Point Bundle from the Marketplace.

sc: A Magic XP lamp is given as a reward on completion of the quest Wiz Kid.
Medium Prayer XP lamp is a reward from the miniquest Eye for an Eye.
The mega-phonus is obtained from the Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza Distraction and Diversion.
If players lose this item, they can talk to Balthazar Beauregard to obtain it.
The Mission report is given to the player by the penguins dressed as a sheep after telling them the secret phrase, Do not trust the walrus.
Moonlight Enchanter robe bottom is a legs slot cosmetic override that is unlocked through the Academy of Skillers promotion from Treasure Hunter.
A mycelium poncho web is a part of the mycelium web armour set bought from the Merchant in the Polypore dungeon.
It forms the basis of the various magic armours that can be made from drops in the dungeon.
It can be made into 10 Glimmer of light (naïve skinweaver) scrolls by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 0.

It can be purchased from Flynn's Mace Market in Falador, or found as a possible reward by looting bronze chests with Bronze keys in the Shades of Mort'ton minigame.
As with all black equipment, this item cannot be made using the Smithing skill.
The ice-dyed off-hand drygore longsword is made by dyeing a off-hand drygore longsword with ice dye.
Phoenix Wing Backpack is an override unlocked by redeeming a Phoenix Wing backpack token or occasionally by rubbing a Phoenix lamp.
Piscatorian cottontail rabbits can be obtained by checking a Piscatorian cottontail rabbit (unchecked) or by breeding a Rellekkan cream rabbit with a Rellekkan cream rabbit or common brown rabbit.

Poison bomb.x: A poison bomb is a bomb potion that can be thrown to create a 3x3 area for 6 seconds which applies poison to monsters standing in it. It can be made at level 99 Herblore in a bomb vial using primal extract, clean irit, poison slime, and a weapon poison++. At level 101 Herblore the recipe is improved, which reduces the time taken to make the bomb.

sc: Players can obtain this item by using a hot kettle with a white teapot with leaves.
Complete directions on how to make tea can be found here.
Praetorian's log page 2 can be obtained by excavating at the Kharid-et Dig Site at the ancient magick munitions, praetorian remains, and war table debris excavation hotspots.
It is a possible reward from completing a hard clue scroll as part of the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion.
Heraldic armour cannot be made with the Smithing skill, nor can it be decorated by any players.
A sanctifying potion is a rare item that can be found in Dimension of the Damned.
Players may obtain it as a drop from hulking or unwieldly zombies.
The Saradomin Banner is a pet that could be obtained by collecting 750 Astromancer credits for the Saradomin faction.
Sarsaparilla's dress is found in Sarsaparilla's room in her wardrobe during the Carnillean Rising quest.
The shadow fruit is a type of Jadinko fruit that can be found in the Jadinko Lair, received through the offering stone or from Mutated jadinko drops.
The shaman's leggings is part of the shaman's outfit that can be unlocked after accumulating at least 1,800 Blessings of the Wolf at the Shrine of the Spirit Wolves.
In the original promotion, it could be made by combining 200 spirit wolf blood with a spirit wolf femur, which were available on the Squeal of Fortune from 16 to 26 August 2013.
The ice-dyed sirenic chaps is made by dyeing a sirenic chaps with ice dye.
Sköll boots can be received from killing Sköll in the 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015 and 2016 Winter events.
The statue fragment is an item obtained during the Birthright of the Dwarves quest while inside Hreidmar's memory.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 steel bars, requiring 600 progress to complete, granting a total of 150 Smithing experience.
When dropped by a monster, it will be treated like tiny spiky steel salvage by the spring cleaner.

tx:
There is currently one known purpose for the "Use Zombie head" option. 
There is a unique dialogue that takes place by using the zombie head on Dr Fenkenstrain during the Creature of Fenkenstrain quest.

When a player clicks the "Drop" option, the zombie head will drop from the player's inventory and onto the ground. If a player drops their zombie head, it is considered lost, so it can then be retrieved from Diango, the Lumbridge Swamp, or the player's toy box.
